name: team
description: Team board: several people, each on their own Claude account, work on one git repository together. Tasks with claims, path locks, dependencies and handoffs, messages and a decision log live on a separate board branch, synced through the shared remote; a claim that loses a push race is redone on the newest board. Hooks brief each session on its tasks and new messages. Standard-library Python and git; never shares credentials or usage between accounts.
